appDescription: Find all 195 countries on a 3D Earth. One guess each. Beat your best score in Atlas.
name: Name
signInToKeepScore: Sign in to keep this score with your account.
membership: The 193 UN member states plus its two non-member observer states: Palestine and the Holy See, represented here by Vatican City. This is a membership-based quiz list, not a list of states recognized by every country.
instructions: Drag to rotate. Scroll or pinch to zoom. Click a country, or skip it. One guess per country.
rankingInstructions: Accuracy is out of 195. Ties use the time of your last correct answer. The clock never pauses.
keyboardInstructions: Keyboard: arrows rotate, +/− zoom, Enter selects the center.
credits: Natural Earth boundaries · NASA imagery. Generalized coastlines and disputed boundaries. Guest rankings are for practice.
restartNotice: The current run won't be ranked.
